THIS CCC IS FILED UNDER ARTICLE 215 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, R/W SECTIONS 11 AND 12 OF CONTEMPT OF COURT ACT 1971, PRAYING TO INITIATE CONTEMPT PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE ACCUSED AND TO PUNISH HIM FOR HIS WILLFUL DISOBEDIENCE TO THE ORDER PASSED BY THIS HON'BLE COURT IN W.P.NO.10675/2023 (LA-RES)
DATED 08.11.2023 (ANNEXURE-A), THEREBY TO CAUSE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE ORDER OF THIS HON'BLE HIGH COURT IN ITS TRUE SPIRIT AND THUS UPHOLD THE DIGNITY AND MAJESTY OF LAW BY CONSIDERING THE REPRESENTATION AND PASSING THE AWARD AMOUNT AS CLAIMED BY THE COMPLAINANT AND TO PASS SUCH OTHER CONSEQUENTIAL RELIEFS AS DEEMS FIT BY THIS HON'BLE COURT BY IMPOSING COSTS OF THESE PROCEEDINGS.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC:26760-DB  CCC No. 501 of 2024 CORAM : HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE  N.V. ANJARIA  and  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K.V. ARAVIND
ORAL ORDER (PER : HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE N.V. ANJARIA)

The direction passed by learned Single Judge in the order dated 08.11.2023 while disposing of the writ petition was to direct the respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner within stipulated time.
The representation was with regard to releasing of compensation which the petitioner claimed on account of acquisition of his land.

2. When the petition came up for consideration today, learned Additional Government Advocate Smt.Pramodini Kishan files the compliance affidavit dated 10.07.2024 stating that the decision is taken as per the direction of learned Single Judge.
Endorsement/decision dated 09.07.2024 was produced on record.

sentences.text: Copy of the compliance affidavit together with the copy of the said endorsement dated 09.07.2024 is made available to learned advocate for the petitioner.
The endorsement dated 09.07.2024 issued by the competent authority by the respondent marks the compliance of the direction of learned Single Judge.
5. The present contempt petition does not survive.
It is accordingly disposed of.

It is clarified that if the complainant has any grievance about the endorsement/order dated 09.07.2024, it will be open for the complainant to file independent proceedings to challenge the same in accordance with law, however, in respect of such recourse, this Court does not express any opinion on merits thereof.

Sd/-
